inspection.uncertainty: These source layers are actor-scoped and function-scoped. Two iwi do not establish Maori consensus; Tribunal interpretation does not establish a timeless national view; Public Service Commission conduct framing does not establish Crown consensus or legal effect. Legal holdings remain LAW-owned, exact Treaty wording remains TEXT-owned, and occurrence chronology remains EVENT-owned.
